== Published English Original Virtual Set 9 wording ==
The early slip allows any Throne Room, has no printed once-per-turn or distance limit on the battle destiny cancellation, and grants a separate captive-Luke shuffle. The 17 September 2007 slip excludes Episode I Throne Rooms, limits the cancellation by timing and distance and drops the shuffle. The earlier full card’s just-drawn phrase expresses the same response timing as the original cancel action.
